description: React component for editing outgoing webhooks in Mattermost, including UI rendering, form handling, and confirmation modal logic.

classes.name: EditOutgoingWebhook
classes.description: React component class for editing outgoing webhooks, managing state, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches the outgoing webhook data when component mounts if webhooks are enabled.

methods.name: editOutgoingHook
methods.description: Handles editing of the webhook, compares current and new data, and prompts for confirmation if needed.

methods.name: submitHook
methods.description: Submits the updated webhook data, navigates on success, and handles errors.

methods.name: renderExtra
methods.description: Renders the confirmation modal with messages and buttons.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main component UI, including loading state and the webhook editing form.
